Axiom: Every spec carries at least one diagram in an `Overview` section, high up — the shape of what this spec describes, at a glance: for an interface spec, who produces vs consumes the contract, or the version-transition flow; for an infra spec, the developer workflow or tool pipeline. The floor is one (mermaid or ASCII), held by tooling: `sdd-check` fails a missing section (`SDD_NO_DIAGRAM_BLOCK`) or an empty one (`SDD_DIAGRAM_BLOCK_EMPTY`). Beyond the floor the author adds more views by judgment; that is not a gate.
